prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: wide landscape 16:9 Chinese cultivation game's farm-management overview, high-fidelity visual direction.
Primary request: The player must SEE AND MANAGE A REAL PATCH OF FARMLAND. Create a beautiful, credible farming management game screen with an expansive playable field, small plot labels and a small contextual action slip. The entire FIELD is the main subject.
Reference image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use its Chinese ink-and-gouache paper-painting style, muted gray-green bamboo, blue-gray rocks, warm earth, stone terraces, old Chinese buildings, gentle natural light. Create a new much closer farming composition. Do not reproduce its distant mountain-overview composition or its deer and cranes.

Scene and camera: fairly close elevated three-quarter overhead game view of a cultivated medicinal garden at 瑶圃峰. About 80 percent of the visible space should read as actual farmland, plants, earthen ridges and narrow paths. Show 6 generously sized, individually distinguishable irregular rectangular terraced field beds, following the gentle slope, all grounded in the same continuous landscape. Clear repeated ploughed furrows, low earthen berms and a few stone retaining edges. A shallow irrigation channel runs along one side, with a simple stone crossing. A small bamboo tool shelter and drying rack sit at the outer edge; distant bamboo, rocks and the corner of a modest gray-roofed building provide a small amount of context. Keep the sky almost absent. No humans, silhouettes, animals, giant buildings, glowing magical props.

Farmland content: Two beds are covered in dense neat rows of mature white down-hanging bell flowers with long green leaves, clearly inspired by lily-of-the-valley. Two other beds have shorter young plants in tidy rows at different growth stages. One bed is visibly bare tilled soil with furrows, ready for sowing. The last outer bed/patch is rough grassy uncultivated ground with a few stones; it visually promises future land improvement. Plants must grow physically as MANY SMALL PLANTS IN ROWS within each bed, integrated into the ground, not a single oversized material icon on a mound. The density of green growth, brown empty furrows and grassy ground must convey the player's actual farming work. This field count is an illustrative layout only, not a mechanical capacity.

UI: Match a refined Chinese ink-and-paper game HUD. Simple pale paper slips with dark readable Chinese calligraphy-like type, muted green selection and warm earthen palette. Top left small location title text exactly: “瑶圃药田”. Top right a small button exactly: “返回”. Keep the central field open, no permanent right sidebar, no large details panel, no dark dashboard, no card grid.
Only 3 or 4 tiny unobtrusive field tags anchored beside beds, never all covering plants: “雾铃花 · 可采收”, “雾铃花 · 生长中”, “空田 · 待播种”, “待开垦”. Select ONE mature bed with a thin restrained muted green edge along its actual ground boundary, no glow. Near the bottom edge, one compact shallow horizontal paper action slip covering less than 12 percent of image height, with text exactly “东畦 · 雾铃花”, secondary text “花已开，可采收”, small action buttons “采收” and “取消”. It must leave the whole field visible. No invented numbers, currency balances, formulae, timer values, percentages, yields, debug text or explanatory captions in the image.

Quality: beautiful but usable polished 2D game visual direction, textured Chinese ink and gouache on matte paper, soft intermediate tones, tactile readable tilled EARTH, broad physical FIELD SPACE with varied crop coverage. This should instantly feel like tending and expanding one's own small farm. Avoid photorealism, 3D render, glossy mobile-game graphics, bright fantasy neon, floating plot cards, big inventory-item illustrations, business dashboards, tiny farmland lost in a scenic panorama, watermarks and Latin text.
